title: AION 2 Gathering: Skills and Node Routes
description: Start AION 2 gathering, track Essence Extraction proficiency, choose specialization skills, complete promotions and build useful material routes.
summary: Read node requirements, track gathering proficiency separately from crafting and choose materials for your next recipe. Compare a short route with the cost of buying the batch.
quickAnswer: On Global, start with an accessible node during early leveling and track proficiency under Essence Extraction. Check the node requirement, gather materials for a recipe and follow a promotion quest when your stage is capped.
